svg.title: Figure 2. Every fault tree, and what backs its events
svg.desc: Figure 2. SG-01 (uncontrollable lateral motion, or steering actuation while not engaged): 28 events · all backed or reasoned; 74 FMEA modes reach it, 60 in the tree, 14 justified, 0 tree gaps. SG-02 (loss or degradation of lateral control without adequate take-over warning): 27 events · 1 without FMEA: BE-2.14; 36 FMEA modes reach it, 35 in the tree, 1 justified, 0 tree gaps. SG-03 (unintended acceleration): 29 events · all backed or reasoned; 43 FMEA modes reach it, 32 in the tree, 11 justified, 0 tree gaps. SG-04 (deceleration beyond what following traffic and the driver can control): 35 events · all backed or reasoned; 39 FMEA modes reach it, 33 in the tree, 5 justified, 1 tree gaps. SG-05 (no release on driver brake, cancel or steering override): 16 events · 1 without FMEA: BE-5.12; 18 FMEA modes reach it, 16 in the tree, 2 justified, 0 tree gaps. SG-06 (loss of longitudinal deceleration without take-over warning): 26 events · 1 without FMEA: BE-2.14; 32 FMEA modes reach it, 27 in the tree, 4 justified, 1 tree gaps. SG-07 (suppression, delay or alteration of the stock PCS/AEB): 21 events · 4 without FMEA: BE-7.02, BE-7.03, BE-7.04, BE-7.07; 19 FMEA modes reach it, 17 in the tree, 2 justified, 0 tree gaps. SG-08 (automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not responding): 14 events · 1 without FMEA: BE-8.03; 12 FMEA modes reach it, 12 in the tree, 0 justified, 0 tree gaps.
svg.text: Every fault tree, and what backs its events
Each goal's tree in its real shape. Each basic event is a dot coloured by its FMEA backing; the stalk below it is one tick per FMEA cause.

Leaves include events borrowed from other trees through transfers. Red edges are single-point paths, from the gate logic. Counts are those of fmea_lint.py --report.
